com.bulwark.reformat.notes: Now one panel, Bulwark Premiere Tools, with tabs: Clips (suggest and cut clips from a full episode), Reframe, Captions (gold active-word captions) and Settings. Needs a Claude API key (Settings tab) for clip suggestions; first transcription downloads a 640 MB speech model.

com.bulwark.captiontools.notes: This panel has moved: captions are now a tab in the one Bulwark Premiere Tools panel (update Bulwark Vertical Reformat to get it).
